And they al marueled. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=64}}† And forthvvith his mouth vvas opened, and his tonge, and he {{ls}}pake ble{{ls}}sing God. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=65}}† And feare came vpon al their neighbours: and al the{{ls}}e things vvere bruited ouer al the hil-countrie of Iewrie: {{verse|chapter=1|verse=66}}† and all that had heard, laid them vp in their hart, {{ls}}aying, what an one, trovv ye, {{ls}}hal this childe be?
